article.title: Provisions of sections 3 to 13 not to apply in certain cases.
article.content: The provisions of sections 3 to 13 (both inclusive) shall not apply in case of medical examination or medical treatment of a child when such medical examination or medical treatment is undertaken with the consent of his parents or guardian.
article.html:
41Provisions of sections 3 to 13 not to apply in certain cases.

Section 41 · Chapter IX · page 15 of the Act

The provisions of sections 3 to 13 (both inclusive) shall not apply in case of medical examination or medical treatment of a child when such medical examination or medical treatment is undertaken with the consent of his parents or guardian.
